 After Salman Khan Praising Qazi, Latter Gets Slammed By Manish Goel's Wife For Age-Shaming Remarks
 Salman Khan recently revealed that Qazi is 'killing it outside', hinting that people love his stint on the show. Amid this, his co-contestant's wife slammed him for age-shaming remarks.
 Tags: 
 Bigg Boss 20 
 qazi 
 By
 Priyanka Dutta 
 Published: Nov 17, 2026 
  • 
 Updated: Nov 17, 2026 | 14:20:08 IST

 Salman Khan's show, Bigg Boss , has been grabbing attention. The friendship, arguments, and games inside the house have kept the audience hooked, this season too. One of the most talked-about conversations was between Love Gill and ScoutOP, and recently, in a major incident, the latter had a massive breakdown. 
 advertisement
 During the Weekend Ka Vaar episode, Salman Khan talked to the contestants on the show and slammed Kanika Mann's comments about Qazi being a strategic player. Salman said Qazi is killing it outside , which is true.
 Manish Goel's wife, Poonam slams Qazi for age-shaming her husband constantly
 The singer has been winning hearts for his personality, demeanour, and also his way of speaking against the wrong, something that happened recently as well, for him to be at the centre of attention. However, amid this, his co-contestant's wife slammed him for his remark. Manish Goel, who is locked in the Bigg Boss 20 house with Qazi and other contestants, recently reacted when he was called 'professor'.
 ADVT.
 ADVT.
 Following this, Manish's wife, Poonam Narula, shared a statement on social media, slamming Qazi. In the note, she revealed how, from the beginning, her husband, Manish, has been called by terms like 'Gyani baba' and 'professor'. Poonam added that her husband doesn't understand all these, and thus he didn't react initially, as it started as a prank.
 advertisement
 According to Poonam, Qazi kept stretching it, poking fun, and making age-shaming comments about her husband, which is when Manish came forward and asked him to draw a line. 
 advertisement
 Poonam revealed that Qazi looked at the camera and said that he would make Manish cry, and that was the real reason for the latter to break down in tears. She also defended her husband's reaction, stating that he's a man in his 50s, while adding that while Manish admires Qazi, the other side needs to be visible as well. She called it 'disappointing and immature' for others not to accept someone whose age is 51. 
 The statement from Manish came after he was seen losing his temper, following the constant poking, which his wife tagged as 'age-shaming'. She defended Manish's action, which was visible during the heated argument between Qazi and him. Poonam shared that people often need to look beyond edited footage and understand the difference between acting and being genuinely hurt.
 advertisement.
 Salman Khan said that Qazi is 'killing it' outside
 Last week, in the Bigg Boss 20's house, SocutOP had a breakdown, which happened after his fight with Love Gill. When Scout made a below-the-belt comment, Love reacted and asked Scout not to misuse the freedom he gave her; she was initially laughing. Among those present, Qazi was the first to react as soon as he heard the comment. However, eventually a heated argument broke out between Love and Qazi, with the latter asking her how she could not react when such disgusting comments were being made about her.
 ADVT.
 It was Kanika Mann who felt that Qazi was 'playing safe'. When she said the same near Salman Khan, the actor slammed Mann and revealed that Qazi was the one who was killing it outside. On social media, Qazi is being praised for always being vocal about the wrong things, and people are also in love with his stint in the show.
